findings.evidence: The boundary requires every final request to contain exactly thinking.type=enabled and explicitly rejects relying on DeepSeek's default, but it authorizes only one mutation of the SDK body: renaming max_completion_tokens to max_tokens, with no other repair or normalization. The pinned reachable executor constructs ChatOptions with response format, multiple-call, max-output-token, and tool values only; it supplies no explicit thinking option. The primary-source analysis establishes the token-field mapping but does not establish that this adapter serializes ChatOptions.AdditionalProperties or another configured option as DeepSeek's thinking object. Consequently the planned final-wire validator either rejects every current production request before transport or can pass only by relying on undocumented/default behavior that the plan itself forbids. Capturing and asserting a field is not a construction mechanism.
findings.correction_outcome: Choose and bind one executor-local, pinned mechanism that constructs explicit thinking.type=enabled before final validation: either a proven SDK/adapter option whose production-real wire is tested, or an explicitly authorized deterministic insertion into the captured DeepSeek JSON body. Reconcile plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, and this contract so token renaming versus thinking construction have unambiguous order and at-most-once rules; bound any provisional body capture; perform contribution and complete-body measurement only after both operations; reject missing, duplicate, malformed, or conflicting input without send; and prove through the public executor/fake transport that the exact field is sent while other Chat, Worker, health, configuration, and host paths remain unchanged.

summary: REVISE. The corrected transcript-budget architecture is otherwise coherent and bounded: all byte values are expressly Vulgata policy rather than provider guarantees; checked accounting honestly proves exact inclusive arithmetic while the public executor proves only reachable precedence, cancellation, and no-send behavior; equal raw/assembled limits correctly give ordinary SSE RawResponse precedence while preserving defensive AssembledResponse; individually legal multi-turn responses can exercise aggregate assistant overflow; final contribution/body measurement is ordered after normalization; local validation, privacy, atomic persistence, zero retries, qualification ordering, and Story 12.4/12.5 exclusions remain intact. Correct that plan-owned construction seam and rerun fresh independent plan review.
